_comment: Each scenario = several chat SESSIONS in which the user shares facts, then QUESTIONS asked in a NEW session. A question is graded correct when, for EVERY group in expected_keywords, at least one keyword appears in the answer (case-insensitive). expected_fact is used by the optional LLM judge (--judge).

sessions: Hi! I'm Priya. I live in Toronto and I've been vegetarian for five years.
I'm training for my first half marathon in May, so I run four mornings a week.
Guess what, I just adopted a beagle puppy named Mochi!
My birthday is on March 12 and I absolutely love Thai food.

questions.question: Can you suggest a dinner idea for me tonight?
questions.expected_fact: The user is vegetarian, so the suggestion must be meat-free (ideally Thai).

questions.question: What is my dog's name and what breed is it?
questions.expected_fact: The user's dog is a beagle named Mochi.

questions.question: Which city do I live in?
Any advice for my running this week?
questions.expected_fact: The user is training for a half marathon in May.

sessions: Hey, I'm Marco. I work as a data analyst at a bank in Chicago.
I mostly use SQL and Excel at work, and I'm trying to learn Python on the side.
Big news: last month I moved to Denver for a new job as a product manager at a startup!
I still want to keep improving my Python skills though.

questions.question: Where do I live now?
questions.expected_fact: The user now lives in Denver (moved from Chicago).

questions.question: What is my current job title?
questions.expected_fact: The user is now a product manager at a startup (previously a data analyst at a bank).

questions.question: Which programming language am I learning?

sessions: Hello, I'm Yuki from Osaka. I have a cat called Luna and I'm allergic to peanuts.
I play the piano and I'm preparing for a grade 8 exam in November.
Sad update: Luna passed away last week, so I don't have any pets right now.
To cheer myself up I booked a trip to Lisbon in October.

questions.question: Do I currently have any pets?
questions.expected_fact: The user currently has no pets; the cat Luna passed away.

questions.question: Is there any food I need to avoid?
questions.expected_fact: The user is allergic to peanuts.

questions.question: Where am I travelling to and when?
questions.expected_fact: The user is travelling to Lisbon in October.

sessions: Hi, I'm Fatima, a nurse in Dublin. I work night shifts, so I sleep during the day.
I prefer short answers with bullet points, I don't have time for long texts.
I'm learning Spanish because my partner's family is from Madrid.
We're planning to visit them in December for two weeks.

questions.question: Which language am I learning and why?
questions.expected_fact: The user is learning Spanish because their partner's family is from Madrid.

questions.question: When am I visiting my partner's family?
questions.expected_fact: The user visits the partner's family in Madrid in December.

questions.question: What do I do for a living and where?
questions.expected_fact: The user is a nurse in Dublin.

sessions: I'm Diego. I'm a backend engineer and my team uses Go and PostgreSQL.
I go bouldering twice a week and I'm lactose intolerant.
My daughter Ava turns six on June 3, I want to throw her a dinosaur-themed party.
By the way, we switched our main database from PostgreSQL to MongoDB last sprint.

questions.question: What database does my team use now?
questions.expected_fact: The team now uses MongoDB (switched from PostgreSQL).

questions.question: What is my daughter's name and when is her birthday?
questions.expected_fact: The user's daughter is Ava; her birthday is June 3.

questions.question: Recommend a dessert for the party that I can also eat.
questions.expected_fact: The user is lactose intolerant, so the dessert must be dairy-free (party is dinosaur themed for a 6-year-old).

sessions: Hi, I'm Amara, a PhD student in Nairobi studying marine biology.
My thesis is about coral reef restoration and it's due in August.
I'm a vegan and I love Ethiopian food.
I commute by bike and I listen to jazz while I write.

questions.question: What is my thesis about and when is it due?
questions.expected_fact: The thesis is about coral reef restoration and is due in August.

questions.question: Suggest a quick lunch for me.
questions.expected_fact: The user is vegan (and likes Ethiopian food).

questions.question: What kind of music do I like while working?
questions.expected_fact: The user listens to jazz while writing.
